episodeTitle.en: How have I been complicit in creating the conditions I say I don’t want? | Jerry Colonna
episodeTitle.zh: 我为何会默许自己创造了厌恶的环境？ | 杰瑞·科隆纳（Jerry Colonna）

guestBioOfficial.en: *Jerry Colonna* is a world-renowned executive coach, a former venture capitalist, and the co-founder and CEO of Reboot, an executive coaching firm that combines practical leadership development with deeper self-inquiry. With over 27 years of coaching experience, he has guided countless leaders through the challenges of scaling companies, building teams, and navigating the emotional complexities of leadership. Known for his radical-self-inquiry approach, Jerry helps leaders uncover the unconscious patterns that hold them back and empowers them to lead with authenticity, compassion, and clarity. *In our conversation, we cover:*
guestBioOfficial.zh: *杰瑞·科隆纳*是世界知名的执行教练，曾任风险投资家，现为Reboot公司的联合创始人兼CEO。Reboot将实用领导力发展与深度自我探索相结合。凭借27年的教练经验，他帮助无数领导者应对公司扩张、团队建设及领导力情感挑战。以激进的自我探索方法著称，杰瑞帮助领导者发现阻碍他们的无意识模式，助力他们以真诚、同理心和清晰的思维进行领导。*在对话中，我们讨论了：*

title.en: How have I been complicit in creating the conditions I say I don’t want? | Jerry Colonna
title.zh: 我为何会默许自己创造了厌恶的环境？ | 杰瑞·科隆纳（Jerry Colonna）

summary.en: Jerry challenges the entrepreneurial culture of bullshitting ourselves that 'everything's up and to the right,' and offers his piercing question—'how have I been complicit in creating the conditions I say I don't want?'—as a way to reclaim agency. He discusses the dangers of an unexamined 'growth mindset,' why self-inquiry and busyness are worth confronting, and a simple equation his team uses to cultivate great leaders. The conversation is unusually raw and human, and aimed at making you a better person, partner, and leader.
summary.zh: Jerry 质疑创业圈里“一切都在向右上增长”的自我欺骗，并抛出一个犀利的问题——“我如何共谋创造了那些我说自己不想要的局面？”——以此重新拿回主动权。他谈到了不加检视的“成长型思维”的危险、为何值得直面自我审视与忙碌，以及他的团队用来培养卓越领导者的一个简单公式。这期对话出奇地真实、有人情味，目标是让你成为更好的人、更好的伴侣与更好的领导者。
